messages.content: You are a helpful assistant. No divider lines between paragraphs. Do not use any of these words or phrases: ['beginner']. Write 7 paragraphs or more. (Make paragraph breaks clear.) Finish with "Most people use pressurized tennis balls." and don’t add anything after it.

Could you tell me what kind of balls are used in tennis? Separate paragraphs with a visible divider line. Every divider line must be exactly: "*****". Do not finish until all required keywords/phrases are included: ['beginner']. The final line of your response must be exactly: "Most people use pressurized tennis balls.". Use at most 6 paragraphs. (Paragraphs are separated by a blank line, or by divider lines if dividers are required.)
